notablePrerequisites:
Lightning-Rig Crew does not have summoning sickness.
Pemmin's Aura attached to Lightning-Rig Crew.
description:
Activate Lightning-Rig Crew by tapping it, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Malcolm triggers, creating at least one Treasure token.
Activate a Treasure token by tapping it and sacrificing it, adding {U}.
Activate Pemmin's Aura by paying {U}, untapping Lightning-Rig Crew.
Repeat.
